rationale.ai-review: Proposes an LLM-based system to automatically review and detect code issues.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Distinctive novelty is making AI review comments comprehensible to human reviewers.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated the Carllm prototype.
rationale.general-code: Targets general human-written pull requests, not AI-generated code.
